text:
Lena: quick status check on Optimize toolkit delivery — last I saw we had quant recs drafted and a couple infra deps outstanding. who's owning what?
Omar: I own the int8-nf4 perf + quality checks. done with initial bench, pushing a small PR for quant profiles.
Sasha: I'm on batching/caching config suggestions. drafted a recommended policy: dynamic batch window 20ms, max batch size 64, KV-cache TTL 30s for chat workloads. will PR later today.
Tejal: FYI eng-runtime still needs the kernel fallback patch merged for the nf4 friendly path. that's blocking canary for dedicated. I can pair with Mike if needed.
Mike: I can take the runtime pairing. snag is infra needs to enable the new CUDA kernel flag in staging first. infra-bot, any ETA?
infra-bot: staging toggle for kernel-compat will be enabled by 2024-11-06T18:00Z (per infra ticket #INF-802). tagging @Mike.
Mike: cool, I'll queue the runtime PR for review once infra flips the flag.
Omar: quick note — quantized model passed perplexity checks but failed a small rerank regression on one prompt set (rank-drop ~6%). attaching log: https://redwood.link/rerank-log-3112
Sasha: that's the regression alert I mentioned this morning. can we isolate if it's post-softmax instability or embedding drift?
Omar: preliminary looks like embedding drift on longer contexts. suspect KV-cache prefix behaviors + quant noise stacking.
Tejal: action items: (1) eng-ml to run targeted embedding stability sweep on 4 prompt families (Omar) (2) eng-runtime to add a short-circuit to avoid cache reuse for contexts > 2k while we diagnose (Mike) (3) infra to enable staging kernel flag (infra-bot) (4) eng-platform to draft canary plan with rollback thresholds (Lena/Sasha).
Lena: I'll draft the canary plan. proposed thresholds: latency increase <= 10ms p95, rerank drop <= 2% OR immediate rollback. ok? :thinking_face:
Sasha: sounds right. also add a gradual traffic ramp: 0->5->20->50% over 2hr with health checks at each step.
Tejal: can we add a synthetic prompt set to the canary health check that targets the failing rerank case? helps catch before ramping.
Omar: yes — will produce a minimized failing prompt set and add to canary checks.
deploy-bot: deploy checklist created: canary-job-3112345678. steps: enable staging flag -> runtime PR merge -> model pin -> canary rollout.
Mike: timeline estimate: infra flip today, runtime PR within 6-12h, eng-ml sweep in 12-24h, canary start tomorrow morning (PST) if no new blockers.
Lena: ownership summary: Omar = quant QC + failing prompt set; Sasha = batching/caching policy + canary health checks; Mike = runtime change + PR; Infra = staging flag; Lena = canary plan + stakeholder comms.
Sasha: small config snippet for recommended runtime flags (will include in PR):
```
--batch-window-ms=20
--max-batch-size=64
--kv-cache-ttl-seconds=30
--quant-profile=int8-nf4
--cache-prefetch=false    # disable prefetch for long-context fallback
```
Omar: note: for int8-nf4 we also recommend enabling stochastic-rounding=false for deterministic rerun comparisons.
Tejal: can we add a regression alert hook in the console so that rerank delta > 3% triggers a page? not just a dashboard blip.
Lena: yes, I'll add that to the canary runbook and ask SRE to wire an alert.
Mike: one more dependency: model-team needs to vet the pinned model artifact (v3-quant-int8-2024-11-05). Omar, can you confirm version and checksum?
Omar: confirming v3-quant-int8-2024-11-05 SHA256: a3f5...9c2. I'll upload to the artifacts bucket and add link to the PR.
Sasha: if everyone is aligned I'll open the platform PR that wires the health checks and gradual ramp.
Lena: perfect. next sync in-thread: please drop short updates here as you complete items (no meetings). I'm tracking in the delivery board. :white_check_mark:
Omar: started the embedding sweep; will post results in 6-8h.
Mike: infra flag flipped to enabled in staging. running runtime unit tests now.
infra-bot: INF-802 status: staging toggle applied. ticket updated.
Tejal: added the synthetic failing prompt set to the canary checks in my branch, pushing shortly.
Sasha: PR opened: eng-platform#4592 (health checks + ramp). tagging owners.
Lena: thanks — marking owners on board. we'll cut the canary if the rerank sweep shows <2% drop. otherwise rollback and investigate root cause.
Omar: will report sweep results by EOD PST.
Mike: once runtime PR is green I'll request reviews from eng-runtime and eng-ml.
Lena: great. closing asynchronous check-in for now. ping here with short updates. :rocket:
